candidateAudit.title: About the next exhibition at AIL: Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and sever
candidateAudit.text: About the next exhibition at AIL: Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and severe extreme events such as drought. Soil holds histories, stories and belowground storage systems, repositories of information and traces of past worlds, current developments and future scenarios. What is happening beneath our feet? At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) ’03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). Join the extended exhibition program: 6 Oct Exhibition Opening with Performances by Michael Bahn, Johanna Unterpertinger and Christian Prohammer 8 Oct 15:30–17:30 Workshop with Helena Detsch The Organic Painter – Painting

candidateAudit.title: Für alle, die gerade im Wald, beim Wandern oder im Supermarkt nach Eierschwammerl Ausschau halten: Rustikale Schwammerl-Bruschetta mit unserem Bella Grano. 🍄 🛒 Zutaten: 1 Bella G
candidateAudit.text: Für alle, die gerade im Wald, beim Wandern oder im Supermarkt nach Eierschwammerl Ausschau halten: Rustikale Schwammerl-Bruschetta mit unserem Bella Grano. 🍄 🛒 Zutaten: 1 Bella Grano, 350 g Eierschwammerl, 300 g Tomaten, 100 g roten Paprika, 40 g Frühlingszwiebel, 3 Knoblauchzehen, Olivenöl, Schnittlauch, Salz und Pfeffer. 👨‍🍳 Frühlingszwiebel in feine Scheiben schneiden, Paprika und Tomaten würfeln. Öl in der Pfanne erhitzen und die geputzten Eierschwammerl scharf anbraten, kurz darauf die Jungzwiebel dazugeben. Paprika und Tomaten zugeben, 3 Minuten mitbraten, würzen und so lange erhitzen, bis das meiste Wasser verdampft ist. Bella Grano in Scheiben schneiden und in etwas Olivenöl beidseitig goldbraun anbraten. Knoblauchzehen halbieren und die Brotscheiben damit einreiben. Schwammerlmischung darauf verteilen, mit Schnittlauch garnieren und servieren.

candidateAudit.text: We keep on digging and the next artistic research exhibition will open in October – Save the date and join us! Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and severe extreme events such as drought. Soil holds histories, stories and belowground storage systems, repositories of information and traces of past worlds, current developments and future scenarios. ’03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. candidateAudit.title: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Appli
candidateAudit.text: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Applied Photography and Time-Based Media at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, which explores the synergistic potential of student teams from different degree programs. In collaboration with the department Industrial Design, this year’s focus was on the intersection of photography and the object, with particular attention paid to the relationship with set design, styling, casting and narrative. Seen from the perspective of Applied Photography, the object and thus the chair, is a welcome protagonist. Photography’s multiple applied genres are cited here: documentary, fashion, advertising, architecture and the portrait. When the function in Industrial Design coalesces with the idea of the purpose in Applied Photography, the question of factuality emerges. Be not mistaken: The most literal things are often the most confusing and enigmatic. Between what it is and how it is*, worlds unfold. We put the images to work. candidateAudit.text: Kaffee ist in Wien nicht einfach Kaffee. ☕ Mokka, Kleiner Schwarzer, Großer Schwarzer und das war erst der Anfang. In unserem kleinen Wiener Kaffeehaus Lexikon schauen wir uns bis zum Tag des Kaffees am 1. Oktober an, was hinter den Klassikern auf der Kaffeekarte steckt. Den Anfang macht der Mokka, die Basis vieler Wiener Kaffeespezialitäten. Wer es schwarz mag, bestellt einen Kleinen oder Großen Schwarzen. Auf gut Wienerisch also: einen einfachen oder doppelten Espresso. Fortsetzung folgt. ☕ #cafehummel

candidateAudit.title: 🔪 How well do you really know your 80s horror movies? 👻 Rodeho’s Rootin’ Tootin’ Pub Quiz returns to Villa Vida Café — and this time, we’re diving into the gloriously bloody, cam
candidateAudit.text: 🔪 How well do you really know your 80s horror movies? 👻 Rodeho’s Rootin’ Tootin’ Pub Quiz returns to Villa Vida Café — and this time, we’re diving into the gloriously bloody, campy and unforgettable world of 1980s horror. 🩸📼 From slashers and supernatural nightmares to cult classics, monsters and final girls, it’s time to find out whether all those hours spent watching horror movies were actually educational. Hosted by drag artist Rodeho, expect horror trivia, drag, queer community and plenty of questionable knowledge finally getting its moment to shine. 📅 Friday, 23 October 2026 ⏰ 19:30–21:30 📍 Villa Vida Café Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna 🎟 Donation-based 📝 Registration required — reserve your spot via the link in our bio. Come with a team or come on your own — both are welcome. You definitely don’t need to know everything about 80s horror to take part. 🏳️‍🌈 Villa Vida is a queer community space. People of all genders and sexualities are welcome; we ask everyone attending to respect the queer community and one another. ♿ Accessibility: Step-free access, accessible toilet and accessible indoor seating are available. Service animals are welcome. Come for the horror trivia. Stay for the drag, community and the chance to prove that your extremely specific knowledge of 80s horror villains has a purpose. 🩸

candidateAudit.text: Jetzt ohne KI😜 Sommer, Sonne, Soulfood: Das Japanische Food Festival ist zurück! Ihr habt gefragt, gebeten und gepostet – und wir haben gehört: Zum perfekten Ausklang des Sommers bringen wir die kulinarische Vielfalt Japans auf vielfachen Wunsch der Community noch einmal zu euch! Bevor die Tage wieder kürzer werden, verwandeln wir Tonkatsu Gonta powered by Takumi im Schulterblatt 114 in ein Paradies für japanisches Street Food, Tradition und moderne Geschmacksexplosionen. Lasst uns gemeinsam die späten Sommerabende feiern! Was erwartet euch an dem Tag bei uns: Matcha-Kreationen von meachymatcha , Yuzu Cocktails von minato.yuzu, japanischer Kaffee, Futomaki, Yakisoba, Half Ramen ( auch in vegan), Japanese Curry ( auch in vegan), Menchi Katsu, vegane Korokke, Takoyaki, Karaage, Gyoza ( auch in Vegan), japanisches Gebäck und vieles mehr... Kommt mit euren Freunde rum, bringt Hunger mit und verabschiedet den Sommer auf die leckerste Art und Weise. Wir freuen uns riesig auf euch!

candidateAudit.title: 💘 Friends? Dates? Flirting? Something in between? Meet queer people in Vienna without swiping. 📅 Sat, 26 September 2026 ⏰ 19:00–21:00 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 106
candidateAudit.text: 💘 Friends? Dates? Flirting? Something in between? Meet queer people in Vienna without swiping. 📅 Sat, 26 September 2026 ⏰ 19:00–21:00 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna 🎟️ €20 per person · cash at the door 💛 Soli tickets available 📝 Registration required 🌈 Who is it for? Queer people who want to meet other queer people — whether you’re looking for dating, friendship, flirting, new connections, or simply meeting more of the community. You’ll meet multiple people through a series of short mini-dates. Privately note who you’d like to connect with again — romantically, platonically, or otherwise. If you both choose each other, it’s a match. 💌 Contact information is only shared with mutual matches. 🧍 Coming alone? Absolutely. You don’t need to know anyone beforehand. The structured format is there to make meeting people easier, including if you’re shy, introverted, or not into approaching strangers at a bar. 💛 Can’t comfortably afford €20? Soli tickets are available. Request one in the comments when registering — no explanation or justification needed. 🤝 Consent, boundaries and mutual respect are essential. A conversation or flirtation never creates an obligation to share contact details or meet again. Discriminatory or harassing behaviour is not welcome. ♿ Step-free access · accessible seating & toilet · service animals welcome. Please note that simultaneous conversations can mean significant background noise. 📝 Register via the link in bio/event page. Come as you are and see who you click with. 💘

Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenographies for Systems Awareness (Project lead: Mag. Alexandra Graupner; University of Applied Arts), is devoted to creating experiential multisensory spaces – the so called SΫS SPACEs – that help enhancing systems awareness through special sensory cues. candidateAudit.text: Kürbissaison ist offiziell eröffnet und wir fangen nicht beim Latte an, sondern bei Kürbisknödeln aus unserem Grandioso. 🎃 So geht’s: 🛒 200 g Kürbispüree (Hokkaido), 200 g Topfen (fein), Mark einer Vanilleschote, 70 g Grieß, 70 g Semmelbrösel, 1 Ei, 50 g Butter, 1 Prise Zucker, 1 Prise Salz, 1 TL Zitronenschale, 150 g altes Brot (Grandioso). Zum Verfeinern: 2 EL Butter, 2 EL grob gehackte Kürbiskerne. 👨‍🍳 200 g Hokkaido würfeln und rund 20 Minuten weich kochen. Brot in Würfel schneiden und mit Kürbis, Topfen, Vanillemark, Grieß, Semmelbröseln, Ei, Butter, Zucker, Salz und Zitronenschale verrühren. Masse 20 Minuten rasten lassen, Knödel formen und in Salzwasser 20 Minuten leicht köcheln. Abtropfen lassen, mit zerlassener Butter und Kürbiskernen servieren.

candidateAudit.text: The Unsafe+Sounds festival, held annually in Vienna, returns in September with a kaleidoscopic program, offering a multifaceted glimpse into the contemporary music scene and AIL is delighted to once again host one event in the program. unsafeandsounds AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna (Free entry) Overview: 18:30 Panel Discussion, unsafe+sounds in cooperation with the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures (University of Applied Arts Vienna) weibel.institute Affective Histories Timotheus Vermeulen and Christian Höller in conversation with Sophie Publig History is never simply given. It is made through the scales and materials by which the past becomes legible: from sweeping narratives and historical events to gestures, sounds, images, technical infrastructures, and seemingly minor traces SOPHIE PUBLIG is a Senior Scientist researching digital ecosystems. Based at the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, she navigates the intricate networks of online territories. TIMOTHEUS VERMEULEN is Professor of Media, Culture and Society at the University of Oslo and joint director of the Media Aesthetics Research Group. He was a visiting scholar in Art History at Harvard in 2023–24 and will serve as joint Principal Investigator on a project on the politics of tone at the Centre for Advanced Study in Oslo in 2027–28. CHRISTIAN HÖLLER is editor and co-publisher of springerin – Hefte für Gegenwartskunst. Since 2024 he is head of the department Cross Disciplinary Strategies at the University of Applied Arts Vienna. cro

candidateAudit.text: Dürfen wir Sie auf einen Rundgang durch das revitalisierte Palais Todesco mitnehmen? ✨ Das ist neu: ➡️ Im Erdgeschoss erwartet Sie ein neu gestalteter Shop. Hochwertige Materialien, historische Gestaltungselemente und liebevolle Details greifen die Atmosphäre der ehemaligen K. u. K. Monarchie auf und interpretieren sie zeitgemäß neu. ➡️ Ein besonderes Highlight ist die integrierte Schaubackstube: Hier wird die Handwerkskunst der Gerstner Zuckerbäcker:innen live erlebbar. ➡️ Im ersten Stock stehen durch die Übersiedlung der Backstube ins Erdgeschoss nun doppelt so viele Sitzplätze wie zuvor für Sie zur Verfügung. ➡️ Kaffee, Torten, kleine Köstlichkeiten und Aperitifs laden zum Verweilen ein. ➡️ Hier wartet auch die spritzigste Entdeckung des Hauses auf Sie: die Schlumberger Sparkling Bar. schlumberger.sekt ➡️ Im zweiten Stock schlägt weiterhin das historische Herz des Palais Todesco. Ein neu gestalteter Barbereich verbindet den Charme des Hauses mit zeitgemäßen Akzenten. Wie stehen Sie zum revitalisierten Palais Todesco? candidateAudit.text: Die Schnitzelwochen sind zurück! 🍽️ Ab heute dreht sich im Café Hummel alles um Wiener Schmankerl, knusprige Panier und echte Traditionsküche. Auf der Karte warten diesmal ein besonders zartes Fledermausschnitzel mit klassischem Erdäpfel Vogelsalat und unser Mailänder Cordon Bleu, gefüllt mit pikanter Salami und geschmolzenem Mozzarella, dazu Braterdäpfel und Preiselbeeren. Und weil nach dem Schnitzel bekanntlich noch Platz für etwas Süßes ist, gibt’s zum Abschluss warme Himbeer Mohn Krapfen auf Beerenragout. 🍻 Unsere Empfehlung dazu: ein frisch gezapftes Birra Moretti. Also: Serviette richten, Hunger mitbringen und durch die Schnitzelwochen kosten. #cafehummel

candidateAudit.text: Looking for a relaxed way to spend your Saturday evening? Join us for (board) Gayme Night at Villa Vida Café, an evening of games, queer community, and meeting people. 📅 Saturday, 5 September ⏰ 18:00–late 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna Whether you’re a board game enthusiast, an occasional player, or have absolutely no idea what you’re doing, you’re welcome. 🃏♟️🎲 Come by yourself, with a friend, with a partner, or with a whole group. Arriving alone is completely normal—you can join a table and meet people through playing rather than having to make endless small talk. 🌈 What to expect: ✨ Board and card games ✨ Beginner-friendly atmosphere ✨ Queer community & new faces ✨ No need to be competitive ✨ Stay for one game or the whole evening ✨ Bring a favourite game if you want — or simply show up 🌍 Languages: We’re a multilingual community. English and German are commonly spoken, but there’s no required event language. Tables can play in whatever language works for everyone involved. ♿ Accessibility: Villa Vida Café has step-free access and an accessible toilet. The café is non-smoking indoors. Please keep in mind that several games and conversations may happen at once, so the space can become lively and noisy.

Whether you stay with us, grab a drink or a bite, join our events, or simply hang out - your support means everything. candidateAudit.text: Sommer, Sonne, Soulfood: Das Japanische Food Festival ist zurück! Ihr habt gefragt, gebeten und gepostet – und wir haben gehört: Zum perfekten Ausklang des Sommers bringen wir die kulinarische Vielfalt Japans auf vielfachen Wunsch der Community noch einmal zu euch! Bevor die Tage wieder kürzer werden, verwandeln wir Tonkatsu Gonta powered by Takumi im Schulterblatt 114 in ein Paradies für japanisches Street Food, Tradition und moderne Geschmacksexplosionen. Lasst uns gemeinsam die späten Sommerabende feiern! Was euch erwartet: Authentisches Street Food: Von knusprigem Karaage und saftigen Takoyaki bis hin zu dampfenden Ramen mit Chashu Toppping, leckere Korokke und Menchi Katsu. Süße Sommergrüße: Nippon Style Chiffon Cake und feinste Matcha-Spezialitäten. Getränke-Highlights: Eiskaltes japanisches Bier, Melon Cream Soda, japanische Cider und erfrischende Ramune-Limonade. Kommt mit euren Freunde rum, bringt Hunger mit und verabschiedet den Sommer auf die leckerste Art und Weise. Wir freuen uns riesig auf euch!

candidateAudit.text: In less than 7 days, it's finally happening... 🎉 We're celebrating 5 years of JO&JOE Vienna and we want you to be part of it! 💛 Join us on Wednesday, August 26 as we raise a glass to five incredible years filled with unforgettable encounters, amazing events, spontaneous adventures and countless memories. Here's what awaits you: ✨ 16:00 – 19:00 | ikeawienwestbahnhof x joandjoe.vienna Try your luck at our prize wheel at Europaplatz and win JO&JOE & IKEA goodies, vouchers and more. candidateAudit.title: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developi
candidateAudit.text: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developing the project's multisensory scenography – the so-called SΫS SPACE. Aim of the Summer Studio is to prepare the prototype of the scenography, which will be established at the AIL in June 2027 as the centerpiece of the final exhibition of the PEEK project ’SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS — Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness.’ The SΫS SPACE facilitates a physical experience of one's own embededdness within living systems, within complex interrelationships – within a greater whole. It paves the way for relational sensing and thinking – an embodied systems awareness, that can help in coping with complexity, challenges, and uncertainties, and in making good decisions towards sustainable futures. It deliberately reduces the dominance of the sense of sight, placing the emphasis instead on smell, touch, and hearing. Numerous scientists, as well as invited artists, politicians, journalists, children, senior citizens, curators, cultural workers, educators, and teenagers are individually guided through the immersive environment by Jeanette Müller and Paul Divjak and share their responses in photo-based reflections and semi-structured interviews. Their feedback directly informs the prototype. Save the date! 14 and 15 Sep 2026 The SΫS SPACE will open to the public in individual time slots for an exclusive multisensory experience. candidateAudit.title: Catering mit Charakter.⁠ ⁠ 🎾 Ein kleiner kulinarischer Throwback in den Juli: Wir durften auch heuer wieder das Catering im VIP Champions Club, in der Players Lounge und bei der C
candidateAudit.text: Catering mit Charakter.⁠ ⁠ 🎾 Ein kleiner kulinarischer Throwback in den Juli: Wir durften auch heuer wieder das Catering im VIP Champions Club, in der Players Lounge und bei der Champions Night der Generali Open Kitzbühel gestalten.⁠ ⁠ Gerade bei einer Veranstaltung dieser Größenordnung war unser Anspruch klar: Kulinarik zu schaffen, die überrascht und gleichzeitig einen unverwechselbaren Charakter behält. Deshalb verzichteten wir bewusst auf ein klassisches Buffet, stattdessen hat unser Team jeden Teller einzeln angerichtet – für bis zu 650 Gäste täglich.⁠ ⁠ Bei den Zutaten setzten wir auf Regionalität: u.a. stammten Lachsforellen- und Saiblingsfilet sowie Beiried und Ribeye aus Tirol, Erdäpfel und Karotten aus dem Brixental.⁠ ⁠ Hinter all diesen Zahlen stehen vor allem die Menschen, die ein Event wie dieses möglich machen. candidateAudit.text: 🎬 Sapphic Film Series: Rebel Dykes Punk meets feminism at the next edition of our Sapphic Film Series at Villa Vida Café. 🖤 Join us for a free screening of Rebel Dykes, a documentary exploring the lives of a group of lesbians who helped shape a radical queer subculture in 1980s London. Through stories of friendship, sex, activism, nightlife, art and resistance, Rebel Dykes takes us into a world where punk collided with feminism and queer people created their own spaces, communities and ways of living. Rather than presenting queer history as something distant or polished, the documentary is told through the people who were there — the rebels who lived, loved, organised, partied and challenged expectations both inside and outside feminist movements. candidateAudit.text: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to connect with an audience. Join drag artist DaDa JV for an interactive workshop exploring the art of storytelling through drag and performance. Together, you’ll look at how movement, music, character, costume, emotion, and stage presence work together to create performances that leave a lasting impact. This workshop is open to performers of all experience levels, from those taking their first steps into drag to seasoned artists looking to deepen their creative practice. Participants are encouraged to bring ideas, works in progress, or simply their curiosity. Together we’ll explore: • Finding your unique performance voice • Building a story through movement and music • Connecting authentically with an audience • Using drag as a tool for self expression and community • Developing confidence on stage Expect a welcoming, collaborative environment where experimentation is encouraged and every participant’s perspective is valued. Event Details Saturday, August 29 4:00 PM Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna This workshop is donation based. Give what you can. No one will be turned away for lack of funds. Come ready to learn, share, and discover new ways to bring your story to life on stage.

candidateAudit.text: Looking for a relaxed evening of games and great company? Join Gayme Night Vienna at Villa Vida Café for a free community board game night where everyone is welcome. Whether you’re an experienced strategist, a casual player, or completely new to board games, Gayme Night is all about meeting people, sharing laughs, and enjoying a welcoming queer space. Bring your favourite game or choose from our growing collection of board and card games. Come with friends or come on your own—there’s always a table to join. Event Details 📅 Date: Friday, 29 August 🕕 Time: 18:00–21:00 📍 Location: Villa Vida Café, Vienna 💸 Entry: Free No registration is required. Simply drop by whenever you’d like during the evening. What to Expect at Gayme Night At Gayme Night Vienna, you’ll find: * A relaxed and welcoming atmosphere * Classic and modern board games * Card games and party games * Opportunities to meet new people * Delicious drinks and food available throughout the evening * A community space where everyone is welcome Whether you enjoy cooperative adventures, competitive strategy games, quick party games, or social deduction, there’s something for every play style. Who Can Join? Gayme Night Vienna is open to everyone. Villa Vida Café is a queer community café that welcomes people of all genders, sexual orientations, identities, backgrounds, and experience levels. Whether it’s your first visit or you’re already part of the community, you’ll find a friendly and inclusive space. Come solo, bring a partner, invite friends, or meet new people during the evening. candidateAudit.text: Over the past season, every spin, every step, and every dance has made a real difference. 💜 Thanks to your generosity, Queer Salsa Wien has raised over €850 for the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund (QVMAF) this year already. The Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund provides one-off emergency microgrants to queer people in Vienna experiencing unexpected financial hardship. Whether someone is struggling to pay rent, buy groceries, cover medical costs, or get through another crisis, these grants help community members when they need it most. A huge thank you to the incredible Queer Salsa Wien team for organising these classes, and to everyone who has danced, donated, volunteered, and supported this initiative. Every donation, no matter the size, helps build a stronger community based on solidarity and mutual care. Queer Salsa classes will be back at Villa Vida in October but in the meantime you can join their outdoor classes and parties. Follow queersalsawien for information. The Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund is an initiative started by hint.wien and villavidacafe. If you’d like to learn more about the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund or make a donation, visit queervienna.at. See you on the dance floor soon. 💃🏽🕺🏿❤️ 💜 Thank you, queersalsawien ! Over €850 raised for the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund in 2026—thank you to everyone who danced and donated. QVMAF provides emergency microgrants to queer people in Vienna facing unexpected financial hardship. Learn more or support the fund at queervienna.at

candidateAudit.title: What is Café Cache? A café? A bistro? A restaurant? When we first opened, we were a little bit of everything. With time, though, we realised what truly brings us joy: creating simp
candidateAudit.text: What is Café Cache? A café? A bistro? A restaurant? When we first opened, we were a little bit of everything. With time, though, we realised what truly brings us joy: creating simple yet distinctive dishes that celebrate great produce, thoughtful technique, and the creativity of our team. All in a laid back setting, so i guess you can call it casual fine dining :) For the rest of the summer, you’ll find on our menu • Œuf, aioli mayo & chili crunch • Chou, stracciatella & padron peppers • Cucumber, melon & almond salad • Tarte à la tomate • Aubergine, green beans & sweet-and-sour sunflower vinaigrette • Beets, elderflower beurre blanc & seaweed • Corn gazpacho • Mushroom Mapo Tofu Knödel • Arctic char ceviche • Lamb with chickpeas a l’brodo, sauce algerienne And to finish: • Chocolate Chou, pumpkin seed praliné • Yoghurt panna cotta with watermelon granita If you are curious and you want to try it all we propose our chefs menu, which adjusts sizes of dishes to the group size :) A bientot! 📸 again lilliwonka ❤️ And thanks to our producers dirndln_am_feld krautwerk_farm nuart_vulgohafner reiners_bio oberwasser_fisch , Loschenhof Bio Eggs, Waldviertler Truthahn & Lamm Mann and many more !

candidateAudit.text: This Must Be the Place A song we’ve heard and loved so many times. While it may remind us of someone special, it also captures something even more universal: the feeling of being at home, wherever you are. That’s exactly the feeling we hope to create when you visit our café—a place to feel good, discover unexpected flavour combinations, slow down, and simply relax. After all, it’s summer, and sometimes the best holiday is the one you can enjoy right here in the city. Photos 📸 lilliwonka 🧡 Thanks to gela_ochsenherz for the amazing Friday veg & herb drop

candidateAudit.text: I might be doing it all by myself & alone… but it would never be without ALL of YOU that the BEANDEPENDENT coffee shop & micro roastery is now 2️⃣ 🎉 there are just not enough words to express my gratitude towards you . . . it is one of the greatest rewards ever to get that kind of support 🙏 it is one of the greatest feelings ever to get such motivating feedback 🫶 it is one of the greatest honors to work with coffee, serving as a link in coffee’s value chain, connecting origin & destination 🔗 it is the greatest thing ever to get to do what I do ❤️‍🔥 THANK YOU for : … accepting me and for your respect. … your trust. … coming by and coming back. … understanding my concept. … noticing the details and differences. … feeling the diligence. … your interst and all the questions. … your open mind and open ears. … seeing beyond. … your curiosity and the critique. … the compliments that give me confidence. … your feedback and reviews. … telling your friends, family and strangers. … for bringing the kids. … keeping it real. THANKS that you care ! THANKS for making the time & effort I put in worth it ! THANK YOU for making me make (your) coffee ! it makes me feel enchanted ✨ and I never ever take it for granted ! It is immensely valuable to me ✊ I really appreciate all of you greatly 💕 the lovers and the haters. ON TO THE 3️⃣ you know you can count on me to be HERE FOR COFFEE 🩵 Yours truly, Laurent . . . 📸 1 : vividbwsk 🤳🏻 2 : the.beandependent 📸 3 : lippzahnschirm

candidateAudit.text: The exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory is still running till this Friday, July 10! Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Last guided tour: Thur, July 9, 17:00 Memory is not a stable record of the past. Rather than functioning as a static archive, it unfolds as a dynamic process in which traces are continuously reshaped by perception, narration, and material conditions. Across these artistic approaches, [REVERBERATED] invites visitors to consider memory not as something simply preserved, but as something continuously produced through interactions between bodies, technologies, and environments. The exhibition thus explores how the past continues to reverberate within the systems of the present. With contributions by: Agustina Belén Agüero, Lobna Awidat, Phin Anibal, Rimon Alyagon Darr, Ronnie Danaher, Tatiana Del Valle, Hasti Ghasedi, Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz, Hanna Hofmann, Tal Horesh, Mauritius Itzinger, Laura Isselhorst, Dina Karaman, Moritz Klarer, Anna Buchner, Leonard Otterbein, David Ristić, Rajarshi Sarkar, Agnes Schyberg, Aryan Shahabian, Majedeh Shahvelayati, Mehrta Shirzadian, Pauline Simon, Laura Chalabi, People of Soil Photos: Lea Dörl

candidateAudit.title: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafi
candidateAudit.text: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafik In collaborative drawing, two people share a single pen – the line becomes a space of negotiation. A play between control and letting go. Who leads – and when? Impulse meets resistance, conviction meets empathy. Not always a conversation, but always an understanding – a dance on paper. These and other experiments are part of the course “Drawing: Here & Now” by Simon Goritschnig, in which students of the department Drawing and Printmaking explore various qualities of drawing beyond observational study. In the project “Reflex,” these experimental setups are set against observational drawing. Students draw in the cashier hall of the former Postsparkasse, intuitively picking up details from architecture and space, as well as situations of coming together: conversations, movements, gazes. In this process, it becomes visible how public and social space is visually probed and explored. The focus lies on reflection — with, through, and within drawing. With contributions by: Andrea Vairelles, Anna Marino, Beth Sorby, Emilia Schönwiese, Flora Schmid, Hannah Horn, Henriette Sonntag, Leo Hasslinger, Maria Lutkova, Max Offergeld, Nikolaus Kohout, Sophie Schweizer, Anija S Dartizio, Timo Pfeifer, Vera Kügel AIL in cooperation with the department Drawing and Printmaking and Simon Goritschnig Image: Henriette Sonntag Design: Atelier Dreibholz Concept Postcard Editions and Production: Eva Weber

candidateAudit.title: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes
candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes a quiet declaration of care, resistance, and return. Here, the body is reclaimed as homeland, shaped by experience rather than imposed borders. A performance unfolding through turmeric as healing material and the body as living territory. The work is rooted in a deep commitment to women’s health and critical scientific perspectives, engaging forms of embodied knowledge that have long been ignored or erased. The body becomes both evidence and memory, offering its own geography as a space of protection, defiance, and belonging. The performance is adapted to each site, responding to the spatial and contextual conditions of different venues. Mehrta Shirzadian is a performance and multimedia artist and artistic ­researcher working at the intersection of art and science. With a background in molecular biology, mathematics, and computer science, she creates participatory works exploring microbial life, sound, and bodily ecologies, addressing embodiment, agency, and the politics of representation. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.title: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alt
candidateAudit.text: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alternative investment platform that explores the cultural, economic, and emotional afterlife of the collapse of René Benko’s SIGNA empire. Through NFTs, merchandise, video works, and performative sales strategies, the project examines how value is produced through speculation, narrative, and collective belief. Originally developed through public interventions, the project was expanded through a student take over by Digitale Kunst. This exhibition presents new project strands developed by the students: an NFT series reflecting on financial dependency, a merchandise collection appropriating the aesthetics of startup culture and luxury branding, and a series of short-form videos combining influencer culture, promotional performance, and social commentary. Operating at the intersection of installation, performance, and participatory fiction, Renés Collapse Collection invites visitors to engage directly with the mechanisms of speculation, value production, and collapse. candidateAudit.text: In a world that is seemingly always connected, we lose ourselves in constant contact. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A performance and poem by Carla Schwering and Timna Lugstein from by the department of Institute of Fine Arts & Media Art – Photography (Sophie Thun) The phrase "Schreiben wir uns zusammen" that on the surface means something like “let’s write to each other again in more detail” actually implies a postponement. In the performance, the artists type excerpts from their shared chat history in a poetic arrangement on two typewriters facing each other – messages in which they attempt to get closer to one another. The time and effort spent cancelling meet ups, for which there is supposedly no capacity is made visible. With the postcards created for the performance, visitors can reconnect with a long-lost friend. On the occasion of Angewandte Festival AIL hosts a selection of performances and installations in the cashier hall and the current exhibition will have more activations. We will give you an overview, step by step AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 Jul 2026, 15:30 Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) Performance by Leonard Otterbein leonard.ottb The audio performance Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) explores how sound can model processes of memory formation and transformation. Layered oscillations and brief sound textures repeat with phase shifts, gradually overlapping and partially canceling each other out, much like the traces in an overwritten manuscript. The work is inspired by memory research on reconsolidation – in which recalling an event alters its stored form – and its cultural studies counterpart, reconstructivity. The piece is composed of multiple layers of sound that continuously overlap anew, attempting to cancel each other out in the process. In this process, however, the layers are never completely erased, so that fragments of the preceding states always remain Leonard Otterbein is a sound artist and composer with a background in ecology and ecotoxicology, where he studied mixture effects of agricultural pesticides and nanoparticles. His work spans instrumental and electroacoustic composition, examining perceptual thresholds. He works with psychoacoustic effects and approaches sound as spatial and sculptural material shaped by its relation to space. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.title: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsp
candidateAudit.text: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsparkasse as part of Angewandte Festival! 'LIMINAL TRACES. Celebrating Acoustic Ecologies' is a dynamic sound lecture that understands the acoustic world as a phenomenon of resonance, shaped by connectedness and interaction. Through the live-curated interplay of field recordings, physical and digital artefacts, the performance traces sonic imprints deeply embedded in our collective memory, presenting them as a new listening experience. Developed within SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS at the AIL, this solar performance explores the intersections of sound, pop history and solar energy, celebrating concept, improvisation and the (unexpected) emergent. The performance ends when the energy collected by the mobile solar unit runs out. — The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who conceived and initiated SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS, is working since 2023 at AIL with international artists and systems scientists to form experiential spaces by artistic means (scenographies) and to create sensory impressions that help us to better understand and resonate with living systems. During the project essential principles of living systems are transformed into olfactory, auditory and tactile artworks / artefacts and used experimentally. Team: Jeanette Müller, Paul Divjak, Alexandra Graupner, Anna-Maria Irgang

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 July 2026, 15:00 Hypervigilant Performance by Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz iukumukui Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory artscience.ak Constant vigilance can develop as a response to racial discrimination and transgenerational trauma, allowing potential threats to be recognized in advance. This fight-or-flight state activates the nervous system and can lead to chronic muscle tension and bruxism. Teeth grinding occurs as a way of coping with stress during sleep, often driven by societal expectations to suppress fear or anger. Hypervigilant addresses this suppressed anger. Aluminum teeth suspended from the ceiling form a space similar to a cage that oscillates between protection and exposure. Shaped as gong-like instruments, the oversized representation of the artist’s bite is set into vibration during a sound performance to release embodied pressure and reduce tension in the nervous system. Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz’s practice centers on suppressed experiences expressed in imagined worlds. Through performative sculptures and installations, she examines spatial dynamics and power structures. Addressing socio-political themes such as racism, sexism, gender, and sexuality, she builds subconscious environments using reference-based objects and constructions in combination with text and sound. candidateAudit.text: 🇦🇹🍻 ÖSTERREICH IM WM-FIEBER! 🍻🇦🇹 Was für ein Auftakt! 🙌🏽🔥 Nach dem Sieg gegen Jordanien ist ganz Österreich im Fußballfieber – und wir fiebern natürlich mit! Am Montag, 22. Ganz Österreich steht hinter euch! 💪🏽⚽🏆 ⸻ Aktion gültig für alle Gäste, die bis 19:00 Uhr anwesend sind. Gratis sind ausschließlich während der regulären Spielzeit konsumierte Biere. Solange der Vorrat reicht. Nicht in bar ablösbar. Der Rechtsweg ist ausgeschlossen. 🍻😉

candidateAudit.text: V Takumi doufáme, že vám po každém ramenu zůstane jen jedna věc - prázdná miska. Aby si ramen zachoval svou plnou chuť až do posledního sousta, misky před servírováním předehříváme. Díky tomu zůstává vývar déle horký, aroma výraznější a nudle si uchovají svou ideální texturu. 🤗 At Takumi, we hope that after every bowl of ramen, only one thing remains — an empty bowl. To ensure our ramen keeps its full flavor until the very last bite, we preheat our bowls before serving. This helps the broth stay hotter for longer, enhances its aroma, and allows the noodles to maintain their perfect texture. 🤗

candidateAudit.text: Bei uns gibt es keine Massenproduktion – und genau das macht Ensu Kitchen besonders. candidateAudit.text: Binchōtan (備長炭) ist eine traditionelle japanische Holzkohle aus der Region Kii (heute Wakayama), deren Name auf den Holzhändler Binchūya Chōzaemon zurückgeht. Durch ihre extrem heiße, gleichmäßige und nahezu rauchfreie Strahlungswärme ermöglicht Binchōtan ein Arbeiten auf höchstem Niveau, ohne die natürlichen Aromen der Zutaten zu überdecken. Genau diese Klarheit macht sie zu einem unverzichtbaren Werkzeug in unserer Küche. Bei SHIKI verwenden wir Binchōtan, um Nori, Toro oder Wagyu ganz leicht zu rösten – nur für einen kurzen Moment über der Glut. So werden Textur und Umami intensiviert, während der ursprüngliche Charakter des Produkts vollkommen erhalten bleibt. 🔥🍣 #shikiwien #shikiomakase #binchotan #japanesecuisine #omakase

candidateAudit.text: We are delighted to share that our flagship restaurant SHIKI Japanese Cuisine has once again maintained its outstanding rating in the Falstaff Restaurant Guide. With 95 points, SHIKI continues to be ranked among the best Japanese restaurants in Vienna. A very special thank you goes to our kitchen team – and especially to Executive Chef Gerhard Bernhauer and Sous Chef Patrick Grandits, whose passion, precision and daily dedication make achievements like this possible. Such recognitions are always the result of true teamwork – from the kitchen to the service team and everyone behind the scenes who works every evening to create a memorable experience for our guests. And of course, our heartfelt thanks go to our guests, who accompany us on this journey, inspire us, and motivate us to keep striving for excellence. 🙏 Arigatō gozaimasu! #SHIKI #Falstaff #FineDiningVienna #JapaneseCuisine #TeamShiki ViennaDining

candidateAudit.text: Im intimen Rahmen eines separaten Raums entfaltet sich die traditionelle japanische Kunstform des Omakase – „お任せ“, wörtlich „dem Koch überlassen“. Im Zentrum steht ein festgelegtes Menü, das Vertrauen, die besten Zutaten des Tages und die Kreativität der Köche in einem einzigartigen Ausdruck japanischer Esskultur vereint. Die Gäste erleben einen kulinarischen Dialog, geprägt von Nähe und Vertrauen: Jede Komposition entsteht à la minute direkt vor ihren Augen – frisch, puristisch und in vollkommener Klarheit. Zwei Köche widmen sich dabei ausschließlich diesem kleinen Kreis und schaffen mit Präzision, Hingabe und Handwerkskunst eine Atmosphäre, die den Kern von Omakase widerspiegelt. So entsteht ein einzigartiges kulinarisches Erlebnis – ein Ausdruck japanischer Esskultur in ihrer unverfälschtesten Form, mitten im Herzen Wiens. #japanesefinedining #shikivienna #shikiomakase #sushi #sake

candidateAudit.text: Big News aus der Schweiz! 🚨 ⁠ Wir haben mit 1. Oktober 2025 das exklusive Premium Catering für alle flyswiss Lounges in Zürich und Genf übernommen und sind somit neue kulinarische Gastgeber für über 1,7 Millionen Gäste jährlich in 12 exklusiven Lounges – von Business bis First Class. ✈️⁠ ⁠ Mit unserem Kulinarik- und Service-Konzept, das auf Innovation, Nachhaltigkeit und Regionalität auf Haubenniveau setzt, sind wir sprichwörtlich über Grenzen gegangen und freuen uns sehr, dass die SWISS diesen neuen Maßstab gemeinsam mit uns setzt.⁠ ⁠ Ein riesengroßes Dankeschön an unser gesamtes Team, das den erfolgreichen Start in den Lounges möglich gemacht hat. Wir freuen uns in diesem Zuge auch rund 250 neue Schweizer Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit an Bord zu haben – welcome to the family. ❤️⁠ ⁠ Der Gewinn der SWISS Lounges ist ein weiterer bedeutender Schritt auf unserer internationalen Reise – wir freuen uns auf alles, was noch kommt! 🌍⁠ ⁠ #DoNgroup #SWISS #PremiumCatering #TravelCatering #InternationalExpansion #FirstClassExperience⁠ ⁠

candidateAudit.title: Von Herzen: Danke an euch – meine lieben Gäste. Was für ein Sommerfest. Was für ein Tag. Aber vor allem: Was für wundervolle Menschen. Ihr habt den Gastgarten nicht einfach gefüllt
candidateAudit.text: Von Herzen: Danke an euch – meine lieben Gäste. Was für ein Sommerfest. Was für ein Tag. Aber vor allem: Was für wundervolle Menschen. Ihr habt den Gastgarten nicht einfach gefüllt – ihr habt ihn zum Leben erweckt. Mit echtem Lachen, guten Gesprächen, ehrlichem Genießen und einer Herzlichkeit, die man nicht planen oder kaufen kann. Ihr wart nicht nur Gäste – ihr wart der Grund, warum dieser Tag so besonders war. Jede Begegnung, jedes Dankeschön, jedes leere Glas und jeder zufriedene Blick hat mir gezeigt, warum ich diesen Ort so liebe. Das Sommerfest gibt es nur einmal im Jahr. Aber das Gefühl, das ihr mitgebracht habt – das bleibt. Danke, dass ihr diesen Tag mit uns geteilt habt. Von Herzen ♥️ #DankeGäste #Sommerfest2025 #Herzensgäste #Wien1100 #Lokal1100 #LokalWien #WienerGastfreundschaft #GastgartenMomente #GastfreundschaftMitHerz #LokalMitLiebe #WienGenießt #UnvergesslicherAbend #EchteBegegnungen #Gästeliebe #DankeVonHerzen #WienerSommer #FeierDesJahres #GenussImFreien #WirtshausLiebe #GemeinsamFeiern

candidateAudit.title: Ohne euch? Keine Chance. Was für ein Fest! Ich hätte es nicht besser planen können – aber mal ehrlich: Ohne dieses verrückte, liebevolle, fleißige, kochende, servierende, lachende
candidateAudit.text: Ohne euch? Keine Chance. Was für ein Fest! Ich hätte es nicht besser planen können – aber mal ehrlich: Ohne dieses verrückte, liebevolle, fleißige, kochende, servierende, lachende und schwitzende Team hätte ich einfach nur einen stillen Gastraum und eine einsame Bratpfanne mit Identitätskrise gehabt. Ihr habt nicht nur meine Gäste glücklich gemacht – ihr habt auch mein Herz ein Stückchen größer gekocht. Die Küche? Ein Orchester aus Töpfen, Tellern und Timing. Die Stimmung? So harmonisch, als hätte das Herz selbst Regie geführt. Ich bin dankbar bis unters Dach, dass ich euch um mich habe. Ihr seid der Grund, warum mein Lokal lebt. Warum es lacht. Und warum ich nach einem langen Abend zwar müde, aber verdammt glücklich bin. Danke. Für alles. Für euch. Für diesen Tag. Auf viele weitere – chaotisch schöne – Feste mit euch ♥️ #Sommerfest2025 #Teamliebe #Lokal1100 #WienerGastfreundschaft #Wien1100 #MeinLokal #Gastgartenfeeling #RestaurantWien #Mitarbeiterliebe #TeamPower #HerzUndHand #Genussmomente #Küchenteam #ServiceMitHerz #Wirtshausliebe #DankeTeam #DankeGäste #WienGenießt #LokalMitHerz #GemeinsamStark

candidateAudit.text: Die perfekte Abkühlung für heiße Sommertage ☀️ Wenn die Temperaturen steigen, gibt es nichts Besseres als eine Schale unseres traditionellen Naengmyeon (kalte koreanische Nudelsuppe). candidateAudit.text: 𝟒 𝐉𝐚𝐡𝐫𝐞 𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐀𝐧𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐢𝐜𝐤 – 𝐖𝐚𝐡𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐧, 𝐰𝐢𝐞 𝐝𝐢𝐞 𝐙𝐞𝐢𝐭 𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐡𝐭! Heute vor 4 Jahren hab ich das Abenteuer Anningerblick gestartet. Mit viel Herz, einer großen Portion Mut und dem Wunsch, einen Ort zu schaffen, an dem sich Menschen wohlfühlen, genießen und zusammenkommen können. Seitdem ist viel passiert: Tausende Kaffees, unzählige Quargeln und ein paar kleine Küchenkatastrophen – und ganz, ganz viele schöne Momente mit euch, unseren lieben Gästen. 𝐃𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐞, dass ihr uns so treu begleitet, mit uns lacht, genießt und manchmal auch einfach nur da seid. Und ein riesengroßes 𝐃𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐞 𝐚𝐧 𝐦𝐞𝐢𝐧 𝐓𝐞𝐚𝐦 – ihr seid der Wahnsinn! Ohne euch wär das hier nur ein leeres Lokal mit einer leicht überforderten, aber sehr motivierten Chefin. Wir freuen uns auf alles, was noch kommt – mit vollen Tellern, offenen Herzen und hoffentlich genauso viel Spaß wie bisher. Auf die nächsten 4 (oder 40?) Jahre! candidateAudit.text: Liebe Follower, Keksliebhaber und Familie(Mitarbeiter). Diese Saison hatte viele Höhen aber auch Tiefen ( wir mussten unseren Onlineshop am 11.11 schließen, da uns die bestellten Dosen nicht geliefert wurden). Wir haben uns nicht stoppen lassen und dank eures Einsatzes eine gute und erfolgreiche Zeit gehabt. Viel Zeit blieb dieses Jahr aber nicht für Instagram. Wir bedanken uns für eure Treue, die erfreulichen Rückmeldungen für unsere Arbeit und den vielen Zuspruch. Feiert dieses Weihnachtsfest ausgiebig mit euren Lieben und danke, dass wir mit unseren Keksen ein Teil davon sein dürfen. Schaut doch auch mal unterm Jahr bei uns vorbei! Alles liebe eure Keksmanufaktur ✨✨✨

candidateAudit.text: La Soirée Française fait son grand retour le vendredi 29 novembre au Replugged de Vienne ! Présentation du groupe « Les gars d’en bas » : Les gars d'en bas est le fruit d’une rencontre musicale et amicale de musiciens bretons et tchèques autour de la musique jazz et swing manouche. Les textes poétiques du chansonnier polyglotte Grégoire Brun y sont ajoutés pour créer une esthétique Chanson/Jazz/Swing empruntant parfois aux racines d’Europe de l’est des musiciens tchèques. Sur scène, la complicité des personnages crée un spectacle envoutant rempli d’improvisations musicales. Guitares, contrebasse, accordéon, clarinette et saxophone vous emportent vers des sonorités acoustiques, chaudes et naturelles. Cosmopolites, ils vous plongent dans un univers de poésie et de voyage musical. Pour la billetterie, c’est ici : https://www.billetweb.fr/concert-soiree-francaise -----DE----- WiM schließt sich mit der ADFE zusammen, um Ihnen einen schönen Abend am Vorabend des 1. Mai mit einem Konzert aus Chanson/Jazz/Gypsy und einer DJ-Party anzubieten, bei der Sie bis in die frühen Morgenstunden tanzen können! Vorstellung der Band “Les gars d’en bas » : "Les gars d'en bas" entstand aus der musikalischen und freundschaftlichen Begegnung von bretonischen und tschechischen Musikern im Bereich Jazz und Gypsy-Swing. candidateAudit.title: 🍅Why we're increasingly eating cherry tomatoes?🍅 This little vegetable contains: calcium, iron, potassium, phosphorus, vitamin C, E, B vitamins, antioxidant, organic acids and ly
candidateAudit.text: 🍅Why we're increasingly eating cherry tomatoes?🍅 This little vegetable contains: calcium, iron, potassium, phosphorus, vitamin C, E, B vitamins, antioxidant, organic acids and lycopene. This tiny tomato variety is an ideal food not only in winter time, as cherry perfectly replenishes the loss of many healing elements. It should be noted that this tomato has many more beneficial elements than its larger sibling. Potassium contained in the tomato is very useful for the heart, in addition, it removes excess fluid from our body. Iron is simply necessary for anemia. The well-known magnesium helps in adapting to the cold. Calcium is needed to strengthen bones, and phosphorus is needed to improve metabolic processes. The most valuable substance that is contained in cherries is lycopene. It is he who gives tomatoes such a rich red color. It is a rather powerful antioxidant, with the help of which you can prevent the development of diseases such as: stomach cancer, esophageal cancer, intestinal cancer and lung cancer. It is very important that lycopene reduces the likelihood of developing pathologies of the cardiovascular system. With the help of chromium contained in cherries you can easily satisfy hunger, and also prevents the appearance of severe hunger. candidateAudit.text: Wir laden euch ein auf nen kleinen Einblick, was bei uns im Proberaum so passiert. Da der Proberaum aus vielerlei Gründen nicht für mehrere Gäste ausgerüstet ist, findet das im wunderbaren Café Derwisch statt. Und zwar werden am 18.11. ab 20h: Ulrich mit uns in die Klangestalten von nucleus eintauchen, Eyup uns mitnehmen auf eine Reise in eine vertäumte Gewitterlandschaft und Simon wird davor und danach an den Plattentellern stehen und eine Auswahl aus Dub, Reggae, HipHop und allem dazwischen auf eure Ohren klatschen. Warum wir das machen? Erstens weil wir mit euch wieder mal n feinen Abend verbringen wollen und zweitens weil unser Proberaum nach fast 2 Jahrzenten in seinen Grundfesten erschüttert ist und n bisschen repariert werden muss. Wer also Kleingeld über hat ist herzlich eingeladen beim Kommen ne Spende hierfür beizusteuern. Wenns gar nicht gefällt was wir euch zeigen bitte beim rausgehen mehr zu spenden, da wir den Proberaum anscheinend ja wirklich noch brauchen. Wir freuen uns auf viele bekannte und noch mehr unbekannte Gesichter, kommts vorbei, tanz ma a bissl und feiern die gemeinsame Zeit! further information: undamigo karga.sound _ukustik_
